thought.text: Let me check if server is now listening on some port:

reasoning_content:
Now there are other TypeScript errors - the server has many files broken. Let me check if there's a successful old build or maybe the dist already exists from before the crash.

Actually wait - PM2 shows the areloria process is online with new PID after restart! That's good. Let me check whether it's listening on a port now.

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
import time
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

time.sleep(5)

# Check PM2 status
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("pm2 list 2>&1")
print("PM2:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check logs
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("tail -15 /var/log/areloria/out-0.log 2>&1")
print("\nLogs:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
